As a system user

I want to be able to create and manage nomenclature for “Profile”

So that I will have possibility to change values without system deployment

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Check permissions to see nomenclature for “Profile”

  2. Nomenclature name should be “Profile”

  3. Nomenclature has one hardcoded value – “Price profile”

  4. Not to be able to edit/delete nomenclature name

  5. Selecting “Profile” in the nomenclature dropdown will do following:

    1. In right panel list of nomenclature items will be loaded:

      1. Name is displayed in the list

      2. Blue color for active items

      3. Red color for inactive items

    2. “Plus” button is active if user has permission “Create Profile nomenclature”

      1. If no use disabled state (gray color)

    3. “A-Z’ button is active if user has permission “Edit Profile nomenclature”

      1. If no use disabled state (gray color)

    4. “A (Move to top)” icon is active if user has permission “Edit Profile nomenclature”

      1. If no use disabled state (gray color)

    5. “Remove” icon is active if user has permission “Edit Profile nomenclature”

      1. If no use disabled state (gray color)

      2. For the hardcoded value it is not possible to delete it

        1. Remove icon should not be displayed for the hardcoded value

    6. Pagination will always appear

      1. Number of records dropdown will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

      2. 25 is selected by default

    7. Search box will appear in footer

      1. It is possible to search by name

      2. By default search icon is gray and becomes active after typing 1 symbol in search box

      3. Clicking on “Search” icon will run search

      4. “X” button next to search icon will clear search results and will empty the search field

      5. Changing the nomenclature will empty the search field

    1. Footer is always fixed to bottom, so Search Box, number of records and pagination is not hidden on scrolling

    2. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter or leave the field will directly load that page. If page number is not valid or does not exist the field should be cleared after clicking on Enter or leave the field

    3. “Plus” button/A-Z icon is disabled in each page and page is scrollable
